meta.name: deployment-pipeline-design
meta.description: Design multi-stage CI/CD pipelines with approval gates, security checks, and deployment orchestration. Use this skill when designing zero-downtime deployment pipelines, implementing canary rollout strategies, setting up multi-environment promotion workflows, or debugging failed deployment gates in CI/CD.

copy.tagline: 设计可回滚、带安全审批的发布流水线
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你的团队需要规划安全、零停机的软件发布流程
copy.tagline_en: Design gated, rollback-ready release pipelines for zero-downtime deployment
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your team needs to design secure, zero-downtime multi-environment release workflows

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会帮你设计多阶段 CI/CD 流水线：给出阶段定义、部署策略（金丝雀、蓝绿）、健康检查、审批门禁与回滚方案，并排查门禁卡住或部署失败的问题。
howto.when: 当你设计零停机部署、金丝雀发布、多环境晋级流程，或排查 CI/CD 部署门禁失败时触发。

say.text: 帮我为新的 Kubernetes 服务设计一套带审批门禁的 CI/CD 流水线
say.note: 会给出阶段定义、门禁与部署策略

say.text: 我的金丝雀发布一直不晋级到 100%，帮我看看
生产环境部署任务一直不启动，帮我排查
say.note: 会检查环境审批人配置

howto.what_en: Claude designs multi-stage CI/CD pipelines: stage definitions, canary or blue-green rollout configs, health checks, approval gates, and rollback plans, and helps debug failed deployment gates.
howto.when_en: When you design zero-downtime deployments, canary rollouts, or multi-environment promotion workflows, or debug failed CI/CD deployment gates.

say_en.text: Design a CI/CD pipeline with approval gates for my new Kubernetes service
say_en.note: You get stage definitions, gates, and rollout strategy

say_en.text: My canary rollout never promotes to 100% — can you check why?
The production deploy job never starts; help me debug it
